title: Probatio: an agent skill for rigorous review of your own scientific manuscripts
description: Probatio (skill id manuscript-review) is an Agent Skill that reviews a scientific manuscript the user owns. It runs five criterion-targeted passes, an adversarial pass with a steelman filter, claim verification against the whole manuscript, and a pre-delivery integrity gate, and produces an author-facing prose report and a complete findings list, each finding anchored to a verbatim quotation. It supports successive review rounds. Released for public testing.
